_meta.description: Self-test cases for the Legixo take-home Q&A API. In-corpus cases check that the answer is grounded and that the expected source file(s) appear in citations. Out-of-corpus cases (O-*) check that the API refuses instead of inventing an answer.
_meta.how_to_run: Start the API (uvicorn src.api:app), ingest the corpus, then run: python eval/run_self_test.py
_meta.pass_fail_note: 'pass' is filled by eval/run_self_test.py after a live run with real keys; 'notes' are the author's own remarks.
